name: company.greatwork/labs
title: Great Work Labs
description: 35 small task models behind one API: moderation, embeddings, rerank, OCR, speech to text and more.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List Great Work Labs models with what each does and its price. Optional category filter: understanding, safety, search, transform, audio, vision.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Options, output fields, limits and real example requests and outputs for one model id (e.g. moat-1).

tools.name: run_model
tools.description: Run any Great Work Labs model. lingo-1 (language detection); tone-1 (sentiment analysis); mood-1 (emotion detection); spot-1 (named entity recognition); sort-1 (zero-shot classification); topic-1 (topic and format classification); route-1 (prompt task and complexity); sieve-1 (toxicity detection); warden-1 (content safety policy check); moat-1 (prompt injection detection); bait-1 (phishing, scam and spam detection); ground-1 (grounding check (hallucination detection)); atlas-1 (text embeddings); ladder-1 (reranking); pluck-1 (keyphrase extraction); glyph-1 (emoji suggestions); comma-1 (punctuation and capitalization); brief-1 (summarization); mold-1 (structured extraction (json from text)); headline-1 (title and description writing); cue-1 (tool calling (function selection)); scribe-1 (speech to text); who-1 (speaker diarization); align-1 (word timestamps for your transcript); ear-1 (spoken language detection); uhm-1 (filler word detection and removal); clips-1 (highlight clips from long recordings); clear-1 (speech enhancement); prism-1 (image tagging and image embeddings); prism-2 (image tagging and image embeddings); ink-1 (text recognition (ocr)); scout-1 (object detection); cutout-1 (background removal); glance-1 (image captions and visual questions); shapes-1 (sketch to shape). input: text (string or array of strings for a batch), or an image/audio https URL or data URL. options: the model's named options (see get_model), e.g. {"labels": ["billing", "bug"]} for sort-1 or {"threshold": 0.9} for moat-1. Billed per call; the result includes usage.cost_usd.

input.description: Text, array of texts, or an https/data URL for image and audio models

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: The most a run_model call can cost, without running it or spending anything. Same arguments as run_model.

tools.name: account
tools.description: The connected account's balance, this month's spend, caps and auto top-up, plus a link where the user can add credit.

tools.name: wait_for_credit
tools.description: After showing the user a setup_url: waits (up to 2 minutes) until the account has credit, then returns the balance. Retry your call after it returns ready: true.
